operations: Add a narrow persisted base-currency confirmation boundary required before first expense entry.
Compose the existing Room repositories and application use cases into the Android app without adding a DI framework.
Deliver accessible in-app expense entry, edit, duplicate, soft-delete, snackbar undo, and a simple management list.
Deliver accessible category and payment method create, rename, archive, default, empty, error, and recovery states.
Add test-first application, Compose, integration, restart, idempotency, and accessibility coverage for approved SPEC-001 and SPEC-002 criteria.
planner.rollback: Preserve BT-007 repository/schema behavior and all recorded red tests. Restore only BT-009-owned presentation, application-use-case, preference-adapter, resource, test, and build edits from the pre-change inventory. Never clear an installed user database to repair tests. No Room schema change is planned; any unexpected schema change requires migration tests, a revised plan, and a new security preflight.

securityPreflight.scope: Persisted explicit base-currency confirmation using pinned DataStore/lifecycle dependencies; composition of existing Room schema v1 and seedDefaults; application controllers/use cases; active expense list; create/edit/duplicate/soft-delete/one-snackbar undo; category/payment create/rename/archive/default; and owned acceptance/application/Compose/reopen tests. Excludes Room schema changes, hard deletion, installed-data clearing, network/account/telemetry, overlay, general onboarding, currency migration, dashboard/analytics/reporting history, and dependency upgrades.

findings.description: Parse raw amounts exactly once with injected confirmed currency and locale; reject nonpositive, overflow, excess precision, future time, mismatched currency, and inactive references before mutation; never use floating point.
Use a save lock and one UUID token per logical operation across supported recreation and uncertain retry; reconcile Room receipt state before success and reject cross-operation token reuse.
Delete and undo use expected versions and distinct tokens; snackbar dismissal or interruption ends the UI undo permit while the persisted tombstone remains authoritative.
DataStore persists only a validated ISO currency after explicit confirmation; locale suggestion remains unconfirmed and preference failures are recoverable without bypassing the gate.
Run Room and seed work off the main thread, preserve schema v1 without destructive fallback, and require a revised plan, migration tests, and new preflight for any schema change.
Never log financial or user-entered contents, preference values, or receipt payloads; keep all data on device and render user content as plain text.

Tests must cover exact parsing, restart confirmation, rapid taps, uncertain results, stale/inactive references, undo expiry/interruption, seed preservation, management recovery, historical labels, accessibility, and reopen without claiming unrun checks.
